method: Opened final exported PDF rasterized by Poppler, at full-page and eight cropped close-up views. Crops come from the final 4245 x 6000 PNG, not an HTML screenshot.

views.finding: Final PDF full page: three independent columns, balanced header, column-specific content and findings, compact footer.
Title, unchanged subtitle, four equal author names and matching IDs, affiliation; no former time-window or methods blocks.
Readable background/data paragraphs and national chart; first-year Japan label clears the line.
All-region distribution, common axis, medians/extrema and interpretation fit within column.
Manufacturing median/IQR and separately labeled private-services/tertiary panels; CY/FY, zoom and scope notes readable.
Three equal-width association panels, axes/sample sizes, 2019 note and covariance qualifier; no cropped labels.
Separate Japan/USA youth panels, all uncertainty ranges within bounds, hollow/filled note, constructed-rate qualifier and sensitivity note.
Native Tokyo bins including unknown, two-year legend and totals, accounting interpretation; Key Findings last and only in column 3.
Timing and descriptive interpretation note fits inside page border.

limitations: Screen visual inspection, not a physical A0 print proof.
Printer bleed and final team adoption remain to be confirmed.
qa_crop_delivery: Crop PNGs are regenerable local inspection aids excluded by .gitignore; the final PDF, overview and this record are intended deliverables.
